verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents a general checkout liability model — it takes on dispute risk and manages chargebacks with an authorization-hold model — plus scoped spend/allowance controls (order intents, agent card limits, onchain-enforced wallet permissions) that reduce fraud exposure. However, the dispute/chargeback liability documentation is explicitly noted as covering the general Checkout product, not specifically agent checkouts or agent cards, leaving merchants without a clear statement of who bears risk when an agent initiates the transaction. Missing for 10: agent-checkout-specific chargeback/dispute liability terms, explicit merchant risk allocation for agent-initiated fraud, and any documented dispute-resolution process for Agent Cards/Agent Checkouts.
